messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

The text names a member of the Beatles. Which of these songs by the Beatles has this member as its only lead singer?

Text: Paul McCartney

Allowed answers:
- Do You Want to Know a Secret
- Mean Mr. Mustard
- You Won't See Me
- Crying, Waiting, Hoping
